groups.title: Architecture — PI Context-Window Bloat
groups.summary: PI serializes all loaded extension and skill metadata into the system prompt, growing to ~262K tokens — overruns OpenRouter's 200K hard limit and causes ANY live invocation to fail until the session is cleared. Reproduced across slices 20-re (security) and 22-re (skills). Obsidian-memory eventually completed in a separate process with a fresh session (22 min run).

items.title: Lazy-load SKILL.md contents on demand
items.rationale: Eager loading of every SKILL.md inflates the system prompt. Defer file reads until a skill is actually triggered by a slash command.
items.action: In the skill loader, return only {name, description, triggers, slashCommands} at load time; fetch full body on first invocation.

items.title: Audit memory-cycle.ts prompt budget
items.rationale: memory-cycle.ts emits the stale-context warning during slice 18 and contributes substantial system-prompt content. Trim or paginate its restored-memory block.
items.action: Cap the restored-memory section at e.g. 8K tokens and elide older entries; surface a 'memory truncated' note instead.

items.title: Honor --no-extensions for the session itself
items.rationale: Even with `--no-session --no-extensions`, accumulated session state still consumed 282K tokens. Verify the flag truly sheds extension prompts.
items.action: Add an integration test that `pi --no-extensions --no-session -p 'OK'` produces a system prompt under 8K tokens.

items.title: Add pi-doctor check for context-budget overflow
items.rationale: Users hit a cryptic OpenRouter 400 with no signal that the cause is local. pi-doctor should pre-flight the expected system-prompt token count and warn.
items.action: Extend pi-doctor.sh to tokenize the assembled system prompt and warn if it exceeds 150K (configurable per provider).

groups.title: Test Suite — 13 Vitest Failures
groups.summary: extensions vitest run: 1763/1776 pass. Real failures cluster in tool-advisor config, commander-tracker mission-brief forwarding, escape-cancel, extension-inventory fingerprint, interfaze demos, and plan-viewer regressions.

items.title: Reconcile agents/models.json with tool-advisor expectations
items.rationale: tool-advisor.test.ts expects provider='openrouter' but the on-disk models.json has 'openai-codex'. Either the test or the config drifted.
items.action: Run `cat agents/models.json` and decide canonical value; update either the test or the file. If 'openai-codex' is correct, update tool-advisor.test.ts; otherwise update models.json.

items.title: Fix 3 mission-brief forwarding asserts in commander-tracker-mission-brief.test.ts
items.rationale: commander-tracker is the bridge to Commander; broken mission-brief forwarding affects new-task creation visibility on the kanban board.
items.action: Run the failing test, capture the diff between expected and actual brief payload, patch commander-tracker.ts to emit the missing fields.

items.title: Regenerate extension-inventory fingerprint
items.rationale: Hash mismatch in extension-inventory.test.ts indicates the inventory was edited without updating the fingerprint snapshot.
items.action: Run vitest in update mode for that test or regenerate the fingerprint by hand.

items.title: Land missing interfaze demo files (3 file-existence fails)
items.rationale: interfaze-*demo*.test.ts expects files that aren't in the repo (or were renamed).
items.action: Either add the demo files referenced by the tests OR mark the tests xfail with a tracking issue.

items.title: Investigate 2 plan-viewer regressions
items.rationale: plan-viewer.test.ts and plan-viewer-html-regression.test.ts both fail — one on source content, one on HTML output. plan-viewer is user-visible; regressions block the /plan UX.
items.action: Run vitest in watch mode on those files; diff observed vs golden output; fix.

items.title: Investigate escape-cancel lifecycle test
items.rationale: escape-cancel.test.ts fails on ESC context-switch lifecycle. Likely a small state-machine fix.
items.action: Reproduce the failing assert; add a debug log to the lifecycle transition; patch the missed state.

groups.title: Coverage — 42 Untested Extensions + pi-computer-use
groups.summary: 65 extensions audited; only 23 (35%) have vitest coverage. pi-computer-use package ships ZERO unit tests, violating CLAUDE.md TDD rule.

items.title: Add tests for orchestration + viewer extensions
items.rationale: agent-team, agent-chain, pipeline-team, board-viewer, completion-report, plan-viewer, spec-viewer, test-viewer collectively shape user experience but lack unit tests.
items.action: Per CLAUDE.md TDD rule: for each, write a failing test that captures one expected behavior, then patch to green. Start with agent-team (most-used).

items.title: Add pi-computer-use test suite
items.rationale: pi-computer-use/ has bridge.ts (3670 lines), config.ts, permissions.ts and a 2097-line Swift bridge, but no test files. CLAUDE.md rule #2 mandates TDD on every change.
items.action: Bootstrap vitest in pi-computer-use/. Start with config.ts (layered config resolution is testable without macOS) and permissions.ts (mock the OS APIs).

items.title: Add coverage targets to extension-inventory test
items.rationale: extension-inventory currently audits presence; extend it to assert a minimum test ratio per extension category.
items.action: Add an assertion: for every public-facing extension, a matching .test.ts must exist. Fail-fast on regression.

groups.title: CLI — Documented Divergences
groups.summary: Several pi CLI flags accept invalid values silently or have surprising scope semantics.

items.title: Reject invalid --mode values
items.rationale: `pi --mode bogus` currently exits 0 and falls through to text mode. Should reject with the list of valid modes (text|json|rpc).
items.action: Add validation in the mode-parser; mirror how --thinking rejects unknown levels.

items.title: Document or enforce --no-tools across extension-registered tools
items.rationale: `--no-tools` disables built-in tools but does NOT block extension meta-tools (call_tool, tool_search). Users may assume it disables everything.
items.action: Decide policy: either (a) make --no-tools also disable extension tools, or (b) document the exception in --help and add a flag like --no-extension-tools.

items.title: Auto-fall-back to OpenRouter when default provider has no key
items.rationale: If OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set but the default (google) is not, pi errors with 'no api key' instead of routing via OpenRouter.
items.action: Provider selection: if default fails 'missing key', and OPENROUTER_API_KEY is present, switch to openrouter (with a stderr note).

groups.title: Ecosystem — Deprecated + Mislabeled Items
groups.summary: Several extensions and skills are stale, deprecated, or non-canonical and should be cleaned up.

items.title: dream-scheduler.ts crashes on load (TypeError)
items.rationale: Live invocation of dream-scheduler raises "definition.execute is not a function". Deprecated extension is not just stale — it actively breaks pi -e loading.
items.action: Delete dream-scheduler.ts now (already user-approved DELETE-ME) OR add an execute() stub if any consumer remains.

items.title: memory-cycle.ts: module not found "anthropic.js" in pi-ai dist
items.rationale: pi -e .../memory-cycle.ts fails with "Cannot find module '.../anthropic.js'" under pi-ai dist/providers/. Combined with the system-prompt bloat finding, memory-cycle is both an install-fragility risk AND a context cost.
items.action: Audit memory-cycle's require/import resolution against pi-ai bundle; ensure provider modules are listed in the package manifest or use dynamic resolution with fallback.

items.title: summary-mode.ts captures stale ctx after newSession()
items.rationale: Live load of summary-mode triggers "extension ctx captured outside withSession() and used after ctx.newSession()" at subagent-widget.ts:638. The captured context becomes stale after a session swap.
items.action: Refactor summary-mode to pass ctx through the withSession callback rather than capturing the outer ctx; pattern is the same as the warning the runtime emits.

items.title: Remove deprecated extensions (user-approved)
items.rationale: dream-scheduler, gemma-overlay, secure, session-recap are marked DELETE-ME (gemma-overlay last consumer folded; secure superseded by vuln-scanner; session-recap is an empty stub).
items.action: Delete the four files + any imports. Verify no remaining consumers by `grep`.

items.title: Add SKILL.md to qa-automation (or move it out of skills/)
items.rationale: qa-automation/ is 252KB but has README.md instead of SKILL.md, so the standard skill resolver can't find it.
items.action: Either create a SKILL.md pointing to the README, or relocate qa-automation outside skills/ if it isn't actually a skill.

items.title: Fix broken symlinks under commands/
items.rationale: pi-doctor.sh exits 1 because of unrelated broken symlinks in commands/. Hides real diagnostics.
items.action: Locate the broken symlinks (`find commands -type l ! -e .`) and remove or repoint them.

groups.title: Commander Interop — Working but Strict
groups.summary: PI ↔ Commander interop is fully functional (slice 25: 5/7 pass; slice 8: 14/14). The one fail is intentional schema enforcement on task creation.

items.title: Document the cmd task add schema in cmd-plan
items.rationale: Agents discovered the strict schema empirically (--title, --description, --primary-file, --body with ## Steps/Tests/References, --lifecycle-owner). The discovery cost a failing test.
items.action: Add a runnable example to `cmd guide agent` showing the minimum valid `cmd task add` invocation.

groups.title: Observability — Easier Future Tests
groups.summary: The comprehensive test surfaced inconsistencies in how pi reports errors and how slow operations are bounded.

items.title: Add per-invocation soft timeout (env-overridable)
items.rationale: pi -p has no built-in timeout; agents resort to wrapping with `timeout 90 pi -p ...`. macOS lacks `timeout` by default, forcing Python subprocess wrappers.
items.action: Add `--max-duration <seconds>` flag (env: PI_MAX_DURATION) that aborts the invocation cleanly with exit 124-compatible code.

items.title: Surface thinking budget in --mode json
items.rationale: Phase-2 thinking-levels probe showed off→medium emits 0 thinking events while high/xhigh emit 18-20. There is no schema event documenting the configured vs effective budget.
items.action: Add a `thinking_budget` event to the JSON-mode stream at turn start.
